meaning.en: To kill someone in order to take their property.
meaning.zh: 为了夺取财物而杀人。

examples.zh: 警方认定这是一起谋财害命的案件。
examples.en: The police ruled it a case of murder for money.

examples.zh: 他竟为了遗产谋财害命。
examples.en: He actually committed murder for the inheritance.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; criminal context.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，用于刑事案件。

natural: settle one thing and all is settled

meaning.en: Once the key matter is settled, everything else is settled too; or, said fatalistically, to end it all.
meaning.zh: 主要的事情解决了，其余的问题也就都解决了；也指一死了之。

equivalents: draw a line under it all

examples.zh: 把欠款还清，一了百了。
examples.en: Pay off the debt and the whole matter is closed.

examples.zh: 你别想着一了百了，活着才有办法。
examples.en: Don't think of ending it all; while you live there is a way out.

usage.en: Predicate; context decides which sense.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，依语境区分两种意思。

meaning.en: A big, powerfully built man.
meaning.zh: 身材高大魁梧的男子。

examples.zh: 门口站着两个彪形大汉。
examples.en: Two burly men stood at the door.

examples.zh: 别看他是彪形大汉，心思却很细。
examples.en: He may be a big bruiser, but he is very thoughtful.

usage.en: Noun; describes men only.
usage.zh: 名词，只用于男性。

meaning.en: Extremely audacious, daring to do anything.
meaning.zh: 形容胆子极大，什么都敢干。

equivalents: have the nerve of the devil

examples.zh: 竟敢造假账，真是胆大包天。
examples.en: To falsify the accounts takes a shocking nerve.

examples.zh: 这个胆大包天的骗子骗了上百人。
examples.en: The audacious swindler cheated over a hundred people.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; usually critical.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，多含贬义。

pinyin: shì shí shèng yú xióng biàn

meaning.en: Facts are more convincing than any eloquent argument.
meaning.zh: 确凿的事实比任何有力的辩论更有说服力。

examples.zh: 销量数据摆在这儿，事实胜于雄辩。
examples.en: The sales figures are right here: the facts speak for themselves.

examples.zh: 与其争论，不如拿成绩说话，事实胜于雄辩。
examples.en: Rather than argue, let results talk; facts beat rhetoric.

usage.en: Often a stand-alone assertion or closing line.
usage.zh: 常单独成句，作结论。

meaning.en: To endure wind and rain; to work tirelessly through hardship.
meaning.zh: 风梳头，雨洗发，形容不避风雨、长年在外辛苦奔波。

examples.zh: 老一辈地质队员栉风沐雨，踏遍了荒山。
examples.en: The older generation of geologists braved the elements across barren hills.

examples.zh: 几十年栉风沐雨，他终于建成了这座桥。
examples.en: After decades of toil in all weathers, he finally built this bridge.

story.en: Describing the legendary Yu who tamed the floods: 'He bathed in heavy rain and combed his hair in fierce winds' (沐甚雨，栉疾风).

usage.en: Predicate; literary and respectful.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，书面语，含赞扬。

meaning.en: To sharpen knives noisily; figuratively, to prepare vigorously for action, often aggressive.
meaning.zh: 形容紧张地做好准备，准备大干或动手；多含威胁意味。

examples.zh: 两支球队都在磨刀霍霍，准备决赛。
examples.en: Both teams are sharpening their knives for the final.

examples.zh: 对手磨刀霍霍，我们不得不防。
examples.en: The rivals are gearing up to strike; we must be on guard.

story.en: In the Ballad of Mulan the family prepare a feast on her return: 'Whetting knives swish-swish towards the pigs and sheep' (磨刀霍霍向猪羊).
story.zh: 《木兰诗》：“小弟闻姊来，磨刀霍霍向猪羊。”

usage.en: Predicate; often 向…磨刀霍霍.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“向……磨刀霍霍”。

natural: all sorts of odds and ends

meaning.en: A miscellaneous, disorderly jumble of things.
meaning.zh: 形容种类多而杂乱。

equivalents: all sorts of this and that

examples.zh: 他的包里装着杂七杂八的东西。
examples.en: His bag was full of odds and ends.

examples.zh: 下班前还有些杂七杂八的事要处理。
examples.en: There are some miscellaneous chores to clear before I leave.

usage.en: Attributive; colloquial.
usage.zh: 多作定语，口语。

natural: hide the sky with one hand

meaning.en: To use one's power to control everything and hide the truth from the public.
meaning.zh: 用一只手遮住天空，比喻依仗权势，欺上瞒下，玩弄手段。

examples.zh: 他在这个地方一手遮天，没人敢告他。
examples.en: He held this place in his fist, and nobody dared sue him.

examples.zh: 真相不是一手遮天就能掩盖的。
examples.en: The truth cannot be hidden just because someone has power.

usage.en: Predicate; critical of abuse of power.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，批评滥用权力。

meaning.en: Too complicated to explain in a few words.
meaning.zh: 事情复杂，很难用一两句话说清楚。

equivalents: hard to explain in a word

examples.zh: 你怎么辞职了？唉，一言难尽。
examples.en: Why did you quit? Ah, it's a long story.

examples.zh: 这些年的经历，真是一言难尽。
examples.en: These years of experience are hard to sum up.

usage.en: Predicate; often a stand-alone reply.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常单独作答。

meaning.en: Malicious gossip or rumours spread without evidence.
meaning.zh: 没有根据的传言，多指背后的议论。

examples.zh: 办公室里有不少风言风语。
examples.en: There was plenty of gossip around the office.

examples.zh: 别理会那些风言风语。
examples.en: Ignore those malicious rumours.

usage.en: Noun; object or subject.
usage.zh: 名词，多作主语、宾语。

meaning.en: Many years of diligent study in hard conditions.
meaning.zh: 形容多年刻苦读书。

equivalents: burn the midnight oil for years

examples.zh: 十年寒窗，他终于考上了理想的大学。
examples.en: After years of hard study he finally got into his dream university.

examples.zh: 十年寒窗无人问，一举成名天下知。
examples.en: Ten years of study unnoticed, then one success and the world knows your name.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; the number is figurative.
usage.zh: 可作定语、谓语，“十年”是概数。

natural: there are quite a few such people

meaning.en: There are quite a few people of that kind.
meaning.zh: 不缺少这样的人，指这样的人有不少。

equivalents: there is no shortage of such people

examples.zh: 这个行业里，白手起家的人不乏其人。
examples.en: In this trade, self-made people are not rare.

examples.zh: 为理想辞职创业者不乏其人。
examples.en: Those who quit to pursue a dream are far from few.

usage.en: Predicate; formal; follows a topic phrase.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，较正式，前面常有话题。

meaning.en: All descendants, generation after generation.
meaning.zh: 一代又一代的后代。

examples.zh: 这片林子要留给子子孙孙。
examples.en: This forest is to be left to our descendants.

examples.zh: 子子孙孙都要记住这段历史。
examples.en: Every generation to come must remember this history.

usage.en: Noun; often with 世世代代 or 永远.
usage.zh: 名词，常与“世世代代”“永远”连用。

meaning.en: To fight fiercely until the very end without giving up.
meaning.zh: 拼死战斗，直到最后，决不退缩。

examples.zh: 全体战士决心血战到底。
examples.en: All the soldiers resolved to fight to the last.

examples.zh: 面对强敌，他们血战到底，毫不退缩。
examples.en: Facing a strong enemy, they fought to the end without flinching.

usage.en: Predicate; strong and heroic.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，语气坚决悲壮。

natural: catch a turtle in a jar

meaning.en: To catch someone with no way to escape; a sure catch.
meaning.zh: 在坛子里抓甲鱼，比喻手到擒来，对象无法逃脱。

equivalents: like shooting fish in a barrel

examples.zh: 警方布下天罗地网，要来个瓮中捉鳖。
examples.en: The police laid a net to trap the suspect with no way out.

examples.zh: 对手已被围死，瓮中捉鳖只是时间问题。
examples.en: The opponent is encircled; catching them is only a matter of time.

usage.en: Predicate; often 来个/要来个瓮中捉鳖.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“来个瓮中捉鳖”。

meaning.en: Speaking very little; taciturn.
meaning.zh: 话说得很少，不爱说话。

examples.zh: 他是个少言寡语的人。
examples.en: He is a man of few words.

examples.zh: 性格内向的她在人前总是少言寡语。
examples.en: Being introverted, she says little in front of others.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。

meaning.en: Victorious in every battle.
meaning.zh: 每战必胜，形容力量强大，所向无敌。

examples.zh: 这支球队号称战无不胜。
examples.en: The team is said to be unbeatable.

examples.zh: 没有人是战无不胜的。
examples.en: Nobody is invincible.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; often with 攻无不克.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，常与“攻无不克”连用。

natural: clear the clouds and see the sun

meaning.en: To remove obstacles and see clearly; confusion gives way to clarity.
meaning.zh: 拨开乌云，看见太阳，比喻消除障碍，看清真相或重现光明。

examples.zh: 听了他的解释，我顿时有拨云见日之感。
examples.en: After his explanation I suddenly felt the clouds part.

examples.zh: 案件终于拨云见日，真相大白。
examples.en: The case finally cleared up and the truth came out.

usage.en: Predicate; often 有拨云见日之感.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“有拨云见日之感”。

meaning.en: To make a feint then slip away; to make a show of doing something without real commitment.
meaning.zh: 假装刺出一枪，然后撤退；比喻做个样子，不真干或趁机溜走。

examples.zh: 他只是虚晃一枪，并没有真正反驳。
examples.en: He merely made a feint and did not truly rebut it.

examples.zh: 对方虚晃一枪就撤了，大家都被骗了。
examples.en: The other side feinted and withdrew, fooling everyone.

usage.en: Predicate; colloquial; often followed by 然后溜了.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，口语。

meaning.en: Looking energetic and in high spirits.
meaning.zh: 精神饱满，神采奕奕。

examples.zh: 休假回来，他整个人精神焕发。
examples.en: Back from holiday, he looked full of energy.

examples.zh: 晨跑后，大家都精神焕发。
examples.en: After the morning run everyone was bright and lively.

usage.en: Predicate; also 容光焕发 for the face.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。

natural: as if on the edge of an abyss

meaning.en: To be extremely cautious and afraid, as if standing at the edge of a deep abyss.
meaning.zh: 好像站在深渊的边上，形容十分小心谨慎或处境危险。

equivalents: as if on the brink of an abyss

examples.zh: 在这样的高压下做决定，如临深渊。
examples.en: Deciding under such pressure feels like standing at the edge of an abyss.

examples.zh: 他对待这份合同如临深渊，反复检查。
examples.en: He treated the contract as if it were an abyss, checking it again and again.

story.en: The poem ends: 'Trembling, wary, as if facing a deep abyss, as if treading on thin ice' (战战兢兢，如临深渊，如履薄冰).
story.zh: 《诗经》：“战战兢兢，如临深渊，如履薄冰。”

usage.en: Usually paired with 如履薄冰.
usage.zh: 常与“如履薄冰”连用。

meaning.en: A tactic to delay the enemy or the other party and gain time.
meaning.zh: 设法拖延对方行动，以争取时间的计策。

examples.zh: 他答应下周再谈，不过是缓兵之计。
examples.en: His promise to talk next week is just a stalling tactic.

examples.zh: 对方使出缓兵之计，想等援军到来。
examples.en: The other side used a delaying tactic to await reinforcements.

usage.en: Noun; often 使出/用缓兵之计.
usage.zh: 名词，常说“使出缓兵之计”。
